title: TeamLinkt Website Builder — Site Import Payload
description: The complete payload contract for an external scrape-and-translate service: the envelope, and every block and configuration item it may emit. Generated from the live Puck configuration; see x-teamlinkt.generatedFrom. Companion to site-import-contract.md, which is normative.

x-teamlinkt.role: Supplemental, machine-readable companion to site-import-contract.md. The prose document is normative; where the two disagree, the document wins and this file is the bug.
x-teamlinkt.scope: Translation only — how to turn a scraped site into our schemas. Transport, authentication, job submission, retries and re-import semantics are deliberately out of scope, here and in the contract document.
hardRules: Send sparse props. Omitting a prop takes its default; that is the intended mechanism.
Never send null for a prop — omit the key. An empty string means deliberately blank.
Exactly one page must have slug "".
Every tl-asset: token needs a matching assets[] entry, and every declared asset should be referenced.
Content and branding only — never author templateId, templateSettings, theme or zones.
Never emit a prop beginning with `resolved`, nor formUuid.
Respect orgType gating: emitting a restricted block for the wrong org type is an error.
Import writes a draft revision; a human publishes. Optimise for coverage over caution.
Never copy a stock-media default into a prop — those paths are environment-resolved placeholders. Omit the prop instead.

neverEmitBlocks.IntakeForm: Its questions provision a real form record on save. Organizations build intake forms by hand.

orgTypeGating.note: Every other block is available to all six org types.

supported.style=\"text-align: …\": Text alignment on a block element

rules: Convert scraped markup down to this vocabulary; never pass raw scraped HTML through.
Images cannot live inside rich text — emit a separate Image block plus an assets[] entry.
Prefer a real prop over markup: a scraped <h1> belongs in the block's heading prop, and a standalone heading is a Text block with as: "h2".
Anchors must be absolute or root-relative. Strip tracking parameters.
Layout built from <table> or nested <div>s must be re-expressed with Grid, TwoColumn, or separate blocks.

assetMimeTypes.svgNote: An SVG is a script-capable document served from the org's own domain — a stored-XSS vector, not a picture. Rasterize to PNG.

stockMediaDefaults.note: These blocks default to placeholder imagery. The values are not real addresses — the base URL is injected per environment at runtime. Omitting the prop is the correct way to take the default.

storedOnlyProps.note: Stored in puck_data with no editor field behind them. The two resolvedItems are server-owned; Hero.visibility you may set.

templates.why: A template is a taste decision with no right answer, and switching later runs a merge that stamps template props over existing blocks. The org keeps the default so the picker still offers a genuine choice.

knownDiscrepancies.note: Props where the generated bundle's declared type contradicts the value the block actually ships. The schema accepts what the code ships. These are defects on our side, not quirks to code around — report any others you find.

Locations.items[].description.note: Field is labelled optional and its sample default ships null. Either the type is string|null or the default should be "".

Statistics.items[].secondary.note: Sample leaders default ships numbers (14), not strings.

Statistics.items[].value.note: Sample leaders default ships numbers (28), not strings.

changeManagement.rule: Block props are a storage contract. Nothing is ever deleted from or repaired in stored puck_data, so a renamed or removed prop leaves orphaned values behind forever.
changeManagement.forYou: Echo `schemaVersion` in every payload. We reject a mismatch loudly rather than ingesting against the wrong shape.
changeManagement.unknownBlockType: If you believe content needs a block that does not exist here, do not invent a type — emit the nearest supported block and record a diagnostic.

schemaVersion.description: The bundle version you mapped against. A mismatch is rejected loudly.

source.title: Provenance
source.description: Informational — we log it and show the counts to support.

url.description: The site you scraped. Absolute http(s) URL.

pages.description: The pages to create. Must contain exactly one page with an empty slug.

assets.description: Every asset referenced by a tl-asset: token. May be [].

diagnostics.description: Things you could not map. May be []. Please use this generously.

blockId.title: Block id
blockId.description: Required on every block, unique within the page. Convention is `{lowercase-type}-{6 base36 chars}` — e.g. hero-a1b2c3.

hexColor.title: Hex colour
hexColor.description: Hex colour, or "" to fall through to the theme.

assetToken.title: Asset token
assetToken.description: Placeholder for a file we host on your behalf. Every token needs a matching `assets[]` entry; ingest rewrites it to the stored URL.

slug.title: Page slug
slug.description: URL path, no leading or trailing slash, lowercase, hyphenated, no file extension. "" is the homepage — exactly one page must have it. Unique per payload, compared case-insensitively. `view` and anything under it is reserved for entity detail routes.

componentData.title: Block (Puck ComponentData)
componentData.description: One block. `type` selects the schema for `props`. Send sparse props — omitting a prop is how you take its default. Never send null; omit the key instead.

x-teamlinkt.note: The six never-emit block types are defined under $defs but excluded here, so a payload containing one fails validation.

type.description: Block type. Must be one of the 39 emittable blocks.

content.description: The page's blocks, in render order. This is the whole job.

root.description: Always {}. Site chrome is spliced into page root props at load time; anything here is overwritten.

zones.description: Always {}. Legacy Puck nesting field — nesting goes in slot props instead.

site.title: Site branding and settings
site.description: Maps onto our SiteSettings object. Every key optional; `{}` is valid. primaryColor and neutralColor are the highest-value fields in the payload.

contactEmail.description: A valid address or "". A malformed value blocks the org from publishing.

zones.description: Forbidden — we own this. Chrome comes from the template. Send nothing, or all four zones empty.

templateId.description: Forbidden — we own this. The org picks a template. Import leaves the default in place.

templateChosen.description: Forbidden — we own this. The org picks a template. Import leaves the default in place.

templateSettings.description: Forbidden — we own this. The org picks a template. Import leaves the default in place.

theme.description: Forbidden — we own this. Radix theme overrides are template-owned.

showTeamRosters.description: Forbidden — we own this. A privacy setting. Never machine-decided.

id.description: Payload-local join key for `parentId`. Never stored — we mint a UUID per page. "home" is conventionally the homepage.

parentId.description: Another page's `id`, or null for top level. Must resolve within this payload — a dangling parentId rejects the import.

navOrder.description: Sort order among siblings. Use distinct values.

showInNav.description: false keeps the page reachable by URL but out of the menu.

pageType.description: Not importable — every imported page is a standard page. Division pages are a deliberate authoring decision.

ref.description: Matches the `tl-asset:<ref>` token. Unique within the payload.

sourceUrl.description: Absolute, publicly fetchable, no auth. We fetch it server-side.

filename.description: Original name, used for the asset library listing.

mimeType.description: Verified against what the URL actually serves, not trusted. SVG is rejected — rasterize scraped SVG logos to PNG at 512px or more on the long edge.

alt.description: Alt text if you have it. Strongly encouraged.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
diagnostic.description: Something you could not map. Use these generously — a recurring diagnostic is a feature request for a new block. An `error` does not mean abandon the payload.

message.description: Human-readable explanation for the reviewing admin.

droppedContent.description: The content you gave up on, verbatim where practical.
